integrity: The proof starts from the source's exact quadratic for x=|z|^(2n). Viete's product identity and the parametrization A=2|a|cosh(eta) yield the exact log-symmetric radii, while the source phase equation supplies the regular-polygon structure. The boundary law is the Taylor expansion of the exact arsinh gap, not a numerical inference.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the equal-degree case k=n and reorganizes the exact radial quadratic already proved in the cited source. It does not extend the source zero-count theorem, does not treat k<n, and does not claim that the two regular n-gons have the same angular orientation. The local square-root expansion fixes nonzero a while the discriminant tends to zero.
title: Log-symmetric zero bifurcation in the equal-degree harmonic rational family
